name: Pozole Burrito
description: Wrapped in a flour tortilla to walk with, salsa on the side.
longDescription: All the toppings and the broth's flavor, wrapped in a flour tortilla so you can eat it walking through the market instead of sitting down with a spoon. Salsa comes on the side rather than mixed in, so it stays a burrito and not a soup by the time you get to it. We left this one without an invented name on purpose, since no natural Poz-word fit the way Poztada or Poznachos did.

variants.label: Burrito
variants.note: Wrapped in a flour tortilla with your spread and toppings, salsa on the side.

variants.label: Combo Plate
variants.note: Burrito plus chips and a side of vegan beans or sour cream (swap in a 4oz cup of broth instead if you'd rather).
